plugins.name: auto
plugins.description: Workflow-agnostic pulsed loop engine with natural-language commands — runs the auto loop pattern (plan-loop, parallel fan-out, review-fix until only P3 issues remain) as a durable, observable state machine backed by a per-unit ledger. Outcomes-gated emission: recipes declare an iteration block where a gate unit's verdict.decision drives advance/iterate/exit, bounded by max_attempts + active-wall-time — A2 (Parallel Theories+Judge) and A4 (Adversarial Pair+Comparator) re-spawn under bound when the judge says iterate. Operator kill-switch (CLAUDE_AUTO_DISABLE_ITERATION), shape-corruption shields, iteration-crash exit_reason for post-crash diagnosis. v0.3.1 is a structural release: the ledger and tick engines are decomposed into focused modules (no file over 1k LOC) with an import-topology lint locking the dependency DAG — behavior-identical, 434 tests green. Workflow-blind: drives Compound Engineering, native Claude, or any workflow through a thin adapter.
